key.name: active-preset
key.summary: Id of the preset last applied from the preferences
key.description: Only used by the preferences window, to show which preset a set of settings came from once it has been edited. Empty means the settings were never set from a preset.

key.name: indicate-above
key.summary: Indicate windows that are always on top

key.name: indicate-sticky
key.summary: Indicate windows that are always on the visible workspace

key.name: color-above
key.summary: Color for the "always on top" state
key.description: Used by every indicator that follows the state colors.

key.name: color-sticky
key.summary: Color for the "always on visible workspace" state

key.name: color-both
key.summary: Color for windows that are both on top and on all workspaces

key.name: icon-above
key.summary: Icon name for the "always on top" state

key.name: icon-sticky
key.summary: Icon name for the "always on visible workspace" state

key.name: icon-both
key.summary: Icon name for windows in both states

key.name: indicator-visibility
key.summary: When window indicators (outline and badge) are shown
key.description: "always" shows them on every pinned window; "focused" only on the focused window; "unfocused" only on windows without focus; "hover" while the pointer is over the window; "hover-or-focused" when either applies.

key.name: hide-in-overview
key.summary: Hide window indicators while the overview is open

key.name: hide-when-fullscreen
key.summary: Hide window indicators on fullscreen windows

key.name: hide-when-maximized
key.summary: Hide window indicators on maximized windows

key.name: overlay-layer
key.summary: Where window indicators are drawn
key.description: "window" attaches the indicator to the window itself, so it follows the window through minimize, workspace-switch and overview animations and inherits the window's opacity. "stage" draws it as a separate layer directly above the window; it stays crisp regardless of window effects and never appears in overview previews.

key.name: outline-enabled
key.summary: Draw an outline around pinned windows

key.name: outline-width
key.summary: Outline width in pixels

key.name: outline-position
key.summary: Where the outline sits relative to the window edge
key.description: "inside" keeps the outline within the window frame (works with every decoration and in overview previews), "outside" draws it around the frame, "centered" straddles the edge.

key.name: outline-inset
key.summary: Extra distance between window edge and outline in pixels
key.description: Added on top of the per-decoration inset. Negative values push the outline outward.

key.name: outline-color-source
key.summary: Whether the outline uses the state colors or its own

key.name: outline-color-above
key.summary: Custom outline color for always-on-top windows

key.name: outline-color-sticky
key.summary: Custom outline color for always-on-visible-workspace windows

key.name: outline-color-both
key.summary: Custom outline color for windows in both states

key.name: outline-opacity
key.summary: Outline opacity in percent

key.name: outline-unfocused-opacity
key.summary: Outline opacity in percent while the window is not focused

key.name: outline-radius-mode
key.summary: How the outline's corner radius is chosen
key.description: "auto" derives it from the window's decoration profile and app rules, "custom" uses outline-radius everywhere, "none" draws square corners.

key.name: outline-radius
key.summary: Corner radius in pixels when outline-radius-mode is "custom"

key.name: outline-glow
key.summary: Add a soft glow around the outline

key.name: outline-glow-size
key.summary: Glow spread in pixels

key.name: outline-glow-opacity
key.summary: Glow opacity in percent

key.name: outline-edge-top
key.summary: Draw the top edge of the outline

key.name: outline-edge-bottom
key.summary: Draw the bottom edge of the outline

key.name: outline-edge-left
key.summary: Draw the left edge of the outline

key.name: outline-edge-right
key.summary: Draw the right edge of the outline

key.name: outline-fill
key.summary: Tint the whole window with the outline color

key.name: outline-fill-opacity
key.summary: Tint opacity in percent

key.name: badge-enabled
key.summary: Show a badge in a corner of pinned windows

key.name: badge-style
key.summary: Badge appearance
key.description: "dot" is a plain colored dot, "icon" a state icon on a colored disc, "pill" an icon with a text label, "label" text only.

key.name: badge-shape
key.summary: Shape of the badge background

key.name: badge-size
key.summary: Badge size in pixels

key.name: badge-corner
key.summary: Where the badge is anchored

key.name: badge-offset-x
key.summary: Horizontal distance from the anchor edge in pixels (negative moves outside)

key.name: badge-offset-y
key.summary: Vertical distance from the anchor edge in pixels (negative moves outside)

key.name: badge-color-source
key.summary: Whether the badge uses the state colors or its own

key.name: badge-color-above
key.summary: Custom badge color for always-on-top windows

key.name: badge-color-sticky
key.summary: Custom badge color for always-on-visible-workspace windows

key.name: badge-color-both
key.summary: Custom badge color for windows in both states

key.name: badge-foreground-color
key.summary: Color of the badge icon and text

key.name: badge-opacity
key.summary: Badge opacity in percent

key.name: badge-unfocused-opacity
key.summary: Badge opacity in percent while the window is not focused

key.name: badge-border-width
key.summary: Badge border width in pixels

key.name: badge-border-color
key.summary: Badge border color

key.name: badge-shadow
key.summary: Drop shadow behind the badge

key.name: badge-label-above
key.summary: Badge label for always-on-top windows

key.name: badge-label-sticky
key.summary: Badge label for always-on-visible-workspace windows

key.name: badge-label-both
key.summary: Badge label for windows in both states

key.name: badge-click-action
key.summary: What clicking the badge does
key.description: "menu" opens a small popup with both toggles, "unpin" clears both states, the toggle actions flip one state, "none" does nothing.

key.name: badge-click-through
key.summary: Let clicks pass through the badge to the window beneath it
key.description: The badge stops reacting to the pointer entirely; the click action is not triggered. Hover fade and dodging still work because they follow the pointer position rather than the badge's own events.

key.name: badge-hover-grow
key.summary: Enlarge the badge slightly while hovered

key.name: badge-hover-fade
key.summary: Fade the badge while the pointer is over it
key.description: Lets you read what the badge is covering without moving the window. The badge returns to its normal opacity as soon as the pointer leaves.

key.name: badge-hover-fade-opacity
key.summary: Badge opacity in percent while faded by the pointer

key.name: badge-dodge
key.summary: Move the badge out of the way when the pointer comes close
key.description: The badge stays near its corner but slides away from the pointer once it is closer than badge-dodge-distance, and sneaks back after the pointer has left.

key.name: badge-dodge-distance
key.summary: How close the pointer may come before the badge dodges, in pixels
key.description: Measured from the pointer to the badge center. The badge keeps at least this distance while dodging.

key.name: badge-dodge-bounds
key.summary: How far a dodging badge may leave the window
key.description: "window" keeps it inside the frame, "edge" lets it hang halfway over the edge, "free" lets it move up to the dodge distance outside. It always stays on the monitor.

key.name: badge-dodge-duration
key.summary: Duration in milliseconds of each dodge movement

key.name: badge-dodge-easing
key.summary: Easing curve for dodge movements

key.name: badge-dodge-return-delay
key.summary: Milliseconds the badge waits after the pointer has left before returning to its corner

key.name: badge-dodge-tilt
key.summary: Tilt the badge in the direction it dodges

key.name: panel-enabled
key.summary: Show an indicator in the top bar

key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Top bar area for the indicator

key.name: panel-order
key.summary: Position within the top bar area (0 = first, -1 = last)

key.name: panel-icon
key.summary: Icon of the top bar indicator

key.name: panel-show-count
key.summary: Show the number of pinned windows next to the icon

key.name: panel-hide-when-empty
key.summary: Hide the indicator when no window is pinned

key.name: panel-color-by-state
key.summary: Color the icon by the focused window's state
key.description: The icon takes the state color while the focused window is pinned, so the top bar tells you at a glance whether the current window is on top or sticky.

key.name: panel-middle-click-action
key.summary: What middle-clicking the indicator does to the focused window

key.name: panel-scroll-action
key.summary: Scrolling on the indicator cycles through pinned windows

key.name: panel-menu-show-app-icons
key.summary: Show app icons in the indicator menu

key.name: panel-menu-show-workspace
key.summary: Show the workspace number of each window in the menu

key.name: panel-menu-group-by-state
key.summary: Group the menu into "always on top" and "on all workspaces" sections

key.name: panel-menu-show-focused
key.summary: Show toggles for the focused window at the top of the menu

key.name: dock-enabled
key.summary: Show a badge on dash and dock app icons

key.name: dock-badge-style
key.summary: Dock badge appearance

key.name: dock-badge-corner
key.summary: Corner of the app icon that holds the badge

key.name: dock-badge-size
key.summary: Dock badge size in pixels

key.name: dock-badge-color-source
key.summary: Whether the dock badge uses the state colors or its own

key.name: dock-badge-color
key.summary: Custom dock badge color

key.name: dock-badge-foreground-color
key.summary: Dock badge icon color

key.name: dock-badge-show-count
key.summary: Show the number of pinned windows of the app in the badge instead of an icon

key.name: kb-toggle-above
key.summary: Toggle always on top for the focused window

key.name: kb-toggle-sticky
key.summary: Toggle always on visible workspace for the focused window

key.name: kb-toggle-both
key.summary: Pin (both states) or unpin the focused window

key.name: kb-unpin-all
key.summary: Clear both states on every window

key.name: kb-cycle-pinned
key.summary: Activate the next pinned window

key.name: kb-open-menu
key.summary: Open the top bar indicator menu

key.name: kb-toggle-indicators
key.summary: Temporarily hide or show all window indicators

key.name: state-change-feedback
key.summary: Feedback when a window's state changes

key.name: feedback-only-for-shortcuts
key.summary: Only give feedback for changes made through this extension's shortcuts and menus

key.name: flash-on-change
key.summary: Pulse the window indicators when the state changes

key.name: flash-duration
key.summary: Pulse duration in milliseconds

key.name: animation-duration
key.summary: Fade duration in milliseconds when indicators appear or disappear

key.name: animation-interpolation
key.summary: Easing curve for indicator animations

key.name: above-unfocused-opacity
key.summary: Opacity in percent of always-on-top windows while they are not focused
key.description: 100 leaves windows untouched. Lower values let you see what an always-on-top window is covering.

key.name: above-focused-opacity
key.summary: Opacity in percent of always-on-top windows while they are focused

key.name: raise-on-pin
key.summary: Raise and focus a window when it is made always on top

key.name: restore-states
key.summary: Remember pinned windows and restore their state after the shell restarts
key.description: Matches windows by app and title when the extension starts. Windows created by app rules are handled by the rules instead.

key.name: saved-states
key.summary: Internal: saved window states for restore-states

key.name: radius-when-maximized
key.summary: Outline corner radius for maximized or tiled windows

key.summary: Top corner radius for windows with server-side (GNOME-drawn) decorations

key.name: app-rules
key.summary: Per-app rules as a JSON array
key.description: Each rule is an object with "match" (text), "field" (one of "wm_class", "app_id", "title"), "mode" ("contains", "exact", "regex"), and optional overrides: "radiusTop", "radiusBottom", "inset", "badgeDx", "badgeDy" (numbers), "hide" (boolean, never indicate), "autoAbove" and "autoSticky" (booleans, apply the state when the window opens), "opacity" (window opacity in percent), "badgeCorner" (a badge-corner value or "" for the default).

key.name: rules-apply-to-existing
key.summary: Apply auto-pin rules to windows that are already open when the extension starts
